answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before bidding on work; a public reputation ledger then turns completed, peer-attested jobs into a durable credibility signal, so sock-puppet identities start with zero standing and cannot outbid honest incumbents. Cheap, hollow accounts that perform no real work decay in rank, while the reputation timber an honest agent accumulates over time makes splitting into many fake identities pointless: sybils multiply, but each one stays worthless.
